claim: HP Inc. reports non-GAAP diluted net EPS of at least $0.75 for its fiscal fourth quarter of 2026 (ended 31 October) in results published after the US close on Tuesday 24 November 2026.

runs.scenario: If HP publishes the release before the US market closes on November 24 and reports qualifying EPS, a reader applying the stated criterion would resolve YES, while a reader treating the claim's 'after the US close' wording as an additional requirement would resolve NO.
runs.yes_requires: Under the stated criterion, HP Inc. must publish its fiscal Q4 2026 earnings press release on November 24, 2026, Eastern time, within the event window. The release must report non-GAAP diluted net earnings per share of at least $0.75 for the quarter ended October 31, 2026.
runs.decided_by: HP Inc.'s official earnings press release and its publication time in US Eastern time. GAAP EPS and third-party EPS figures do not count.
